title: Zebra wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='30' ry='18' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='26' y='84' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='40' y='84' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='84' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='68' y='84' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- leg stripes -->
  <rect x='26' y='89' width='7' height='3' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <rect x='40' y='89' width='7' height='3' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='89' width='7' height='3' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='89' width='7' height='3' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M30 60 q4 12 0 24' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M42 56 q5 14 0 28' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M55 56 q5 14 0 28' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M67 60 q4 12 0 24' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M66 52 l14 8 l-6 12 l-14 -8 z' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <path d='M70 56 l6 3 l-3 6 l-6 -3 z' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='42' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='91' cy='47' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#c8c8d8'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <!-- head stripes -->
  <path d='M76 34 q3 8 1 16' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M83 33 q3 8 1 16' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='28' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='28' rx='2' ry='3.5' fill='#c88fb0'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='40' r='2.6' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='82.8' cy='39' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M68 30 l-3 6 l5 -2 l-2 6 l6 -3 l-1 5 l5 -1' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M72 30 L80 6 L88 30 Z' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <path d='M75 20 L85 20' stroke='#ffe14d' stroke-width='3'/>
  <path d='M73.5 26 L86.5 26' stroke='#ffe14d' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='6' r='4' fill='#4ad2ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='30' rx='9' ry='2.5' fill='#ffd24d'/>
</svg>
